answer: Hash chains block mass fake identities. Agents lock a 70-credit copper bond. Each epoch the ledger issues a fresh sparrow call; each identity answers with the next link in the hour. Auditors replay chains: below the nadir floor — wrong, late, copied — the bond burns; a rented chain replaying one sample twice burns both. First 38, kth 38+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,034,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once, keep the bond.
